title: Oriented-cycle conjecture for knot cycle presentations
statement: Let $K$ be a non-trivial knot and let $D$ be an $n$-cycle presentation of $K$. Let $G(D)$ be the directed graph whose vertices correspond to the edges of $D$, with an oriented edge determined by the over-under relation between two crossing edges. **Oriented-cycle conjecture.** The graph $G(D)$ contains at least one oriented cycle. This conjecture concerns the structure of directed graphs arising from cycle presentations of knots; the supplied text gives no resolution or evidence establishing it.
source_name: Makoto Ozawa, “Segment number of knots”, arXiv:0705.4348 (2026).
